grammar.summary: 本课以「最早的日历」为线索，集中运用了定语从句、现在完成时与被动语态，并出现 It is possible that / It seems that 引出推断。重点体会论述中如何用定语从句补充考古发现、用现在完成时陈述研究成果、用被动语态客观呈现证据。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 that/which 或关系副词 when 引导定语从句。本课用 that 修饰证据，用 which 修饰点、线、符号，用 who 修饰游牧人，层层补充考古发现细节。

examples.en: They will hardly know which facts to select from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates.
examples.cn: 对于逐渐积累起来的庞大材料，他们几乎不知道选取哪些好。

examples.en: Historians have long been puzzled by dots, lines and symbols which have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusks of mammoths.
examples.cn: 长期以来，历史学家一直对雕刻在墙壁上、骨头上、古代长毛象的象牙上的点、线和形形色色的符号感到困惑不解。

examples.en: The nomads who made these markings lived by hunting and fishing during the last Ice Age which began about 35,000 B.C. and ended about 10,000 B.C.
examples.cn: 这些痕迹是游牧人留下的，他们生活在从公元前约35，000年到公元前10，000年的冰川期的末期，以狩猎、捕鱼为生。

points.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect)
points.explanation: 现在完成时 (have/has + 过去分词) 表示从过去延续到现在、或对现在有影响的动作。本课用 have assumed / have been puzzled / have been able to 陈述历史学家长期以来的研究成果，强调其延续性。

examples.en: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture, for then man was faced with a real need to understand something about the seasons.
examples.cn: 历史学家迄今认为日历是随农业的问世而出现的，因为当时人们面临着了解四季的实际需要。

examples.en: By correlating markings made in various parts of the world, historians have been able to read this difficult code.
examples.cn: 历史学家通过把世界各地留下的这种痕迹放在一起研究，终于弄懂了这种费解的代码。

examples.en: Historians have long been puzzled by dots, lines and symbols which have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusks of mammoths.
examples.cn: 长期以来，历史学家一直对雕刻在墙壁上、骨头上、古代长毛象的象牙上的点、线和形形色色的符号感到困惑不解。

points.title: It 作形式主语引出推断 (Formal it for Inference)
points.explanation: 用 It is possible that / It seems that / It has long been known that 等结构，it 作形式主语，把真正的主语从句后置，常用于陈述推断与常识。本课用它引出对日历年代的推断。

examples.en: It is possible that there is a definite relation between these paintings and the markings that sometimes accompany them.
examples.cn: 有时，这种图画与墙壁上的刻痕共存，它们之间可能有一定的联系。

examples.en: It seems that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20,000 years earlier than has been supposed.
examples.cn: 看来人类早就致力于探索四季变迁了，比人们想像的要早20,000年。

examples.en: It has long been known that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression.
examples.cn: 大家早就知道，画在墙上的狩猎图景并不是单纯的艺术表现形式。

exercises.q: Historians have long been puzzled by dots, lines and symbols ______ have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusks of mammoths.
Up to now, historians ______ that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture.
It ______ that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20,000 years earlier than has been supposed.
下列哪个词与课文中 deduce 的含义最接近？
用被动语态填空：Historians have long ______ ______ (puzzle) by dots, lines and symbols which have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusks of mammoths.（写出 puzzle 的正确完成被动形式，两个词）
